note: Dragon to Pegasus as a westward Silk Road journey (Japan -> China -> Greece is the Silk Road travelled backwards). Golden pearl becomes the sun. 2 seeds.

runs.label: d2p-silkroad-1
runs.prompt: One continuous camera journey travelling west, slow and painterly in every frame. A small glowing golden pearl appears ahead of the ink dragon and flies west, and the dragon follows it, the camera flying alongside. The dragon stays a loose ink brush painting, never 3D, never cartoon. Below them the Chinese ink mountains slowly flatten into the golden sand dunes of the Silk Road at sunset, a small caravan of camels crossing far below. The dragon's body thins into a long ribbon of golden cloud. The dunes give way to a deep blue Mediterranean sea and a Greek mountain with a small white temple on its slope. The golden pearl grows into the sun. In front of the sun, out of the clouds, a powerful white winged horse, Pegasus, rears up in a deep cobalt sky above sunlit white clouds, wings spread wide. Along the way the pale ink wash slowly warms and thickens into rich heroic oil paint. No text, no photorealism.
